                Prepared files

                  Files you prepare show up here with their MD5 fingerprint.

                  Everything runs locally: no video ever leaves your computer.

                  Settings

                  The targets (H.264, short side 1080, 60 FPS) come from public posts observed in November 2026, not from rules published by TikTok. An accepted upload doesn't prove the video wasn't re-compressed: that's what Verify is for.

                  How HQ Upload works
                  1. The problemTikTok often re-compresses the videos you upload, and they lose detail.
                  2. What works todayThe posts TikTok keeps untouched have a few things in common: H.264 format, short side up to 1080 pixels, 60 frames per second.
                  3. What HQ Upload doesIt checks your video, converts it if needed (same engine as HandBrake) and adds a small header tweak used by this method. Picture and sound aren't touched by the tweak.
                  4. Then you checkAfter posting, Verify tells you whether viewers get your original file.

                  Words you'll see

                  FPS
                  Frames per second: how many pictures make one second of video. 60 looks smoother than 30.
                  Mbps
                  Megabits per second: how much data one second of video needs. 8 Mbps = 1 MB/s.
                  HandBrake
                  A free app to compress videos. The HQ Upload preset is a ready-made set of its settings.
                  H.264
                  The most common video format, and the one TikTok keeps untouched.
                  Re-compressed
                  When TikTok makes its own lighter copy of your video, with less detail.
                  Fingerprint (MD5)
                  A code unique to your file. Verify compares it with the file on TikTok.

                  Everything runs on your computer: no video is uploaded anywhere. These traits come from public posts observed in November 2026; TikTok can change its behaviour at any time, which is why Verify exists.
files.handbrake.js:
// Preset HandBrake su misura del file analizzato: H.264 x264, lato corto fino a
// 1080, 60 FPS costanti, RF 18 slow, picchi senza limite (qualità piena), come la
// conversione nell'estensione; dopo l'export serve comunque la patch HQ.
const MAX_SHORT_SIDE = 1080;
const even = (value) => Math.max(2, Math.round(value / 2) * 2);

export function handbrakeTarget(info) {
  const shortSide = Math.min(info.width, info.height);
  const scale = shortSide > MAX_SHORT_SIDE ? MAX_SHORT_SIDE / shortSide : 1;
  return { width: even(info.width * scale), height: even(info.height * scale), scaled: scale < 1 };
}

export function handbrakePreset(info) {
  const { width, height } = handbrakeTarget(info);
  const name = `HQ Upload TikTok ${width}x${height} 60`;
  const preset = {
    AlignAVStart: true,
    AudioCopyMask: ["copy:aac"],
    AudioEncoderFallback: "av_aac",
    AudioLanguageList: [],
    AudioList: [{
      AudioBitrate: 320, AudioCompressionLevel: 0, AudioEncoder: "copy:aac", AudioMixdown: "stereo",
      AudioNormalizeMixLevel: false, AudioSamplerate: "auto", AudioTrackQualityEnable: false,
      AudioTrackQuality: -1, AudioTrackGainSlider: 0, AudioTrackDRCSlider: 0,
    }],
    AudioSecondaryEncoderMode: true,
    AudioTrackSelectionBehavior: "first",
    AudioTrackNamePassthru: true,
    AudioAutomaticNamingBehavior: "unnamed",
    ChapterMarkers: false,
    ChildrenArray: [],
    Default: false,
    FileFormat: "av_mp4",
    Folder: false,
    FolderOpen: false,
    Optimize: true,
    Mp4iPodCompatible: false,
    PictureCropMode: 2,
    PictureBottomCrop: 0, PictureLeftCrop: 0, PictureRightCrop: 0, PictureTopCrop: 0,
    PictureDARWidth: 0,
    PictureDeblockPreset: "off", PictureDeblockTune: "medium", PictureDeblockCustom: "",
    PictureDeinterlaceFilter: "off", PictureCombDetectPreset: "off", PictureCombDetectCustom: "",
    PictureDenoiseCustom: "", PictureDenoiseFilter: "off",
    PictureSharpenCustom: "", PictureSharpenFilter: "off", PictureSharpenPreset: "medium", PictureSharpenTune: "none",
    PictureDetelecine: "off", PictureDetelecineCustom: "",
    PictureColorspacePreset: "off", PictureColorspaceCustom: "",
    PictureChromaSmoothPreset: "off", PictureChromaSmoothTune: "none", PictureChromaSmoothCustom: "",
    PictureItuPAR: false,
    PictureKeepRatio: true,
    PicturePAR: "off", PicturePARWidth: 0, PicturePARHeight: 0,
    PictureWidth: width,
    PictureHeight: height,
    PictureUseMaximumSize: true,
    PictureAllowUpscaling: false,
    PictureForceHeight: 0, PictureForceWidth: 0,
    PicturePadMode: "none", PicturePadTop: 0, PicturePadBottom: 0, PicturePadLeft: 0, PicturePadRight: 0, PicturePadColor: "black",
    PresetDescription: "HQ Upload: H.264 at a constant 60 FPS, short side up to 1080, RF 18, uncapped peaks (full quality). After exporting, apply the patch with HQ Upload.",
    PresetName: name,
    Type: 1,
    SubtitleAddCC: false, SubtitleAddForeignAudioSearch: false, SubtitleAddForeignAudioSubtitle: false,
    SubtitleBurnBehavior: "none", SubtitleBurnBDSub: false, SubtitleBurnDVDSub: false,
    SubtitleLanguageList: [], SubtitleTrackSelectionBehavior: "none", SubtitleTrackNamePassthru: true,
    VideoAvgBitrate: 15000,
    VideoColorRange: "limited",
    VideoColorMatrixCode: 0,
    VideoEncoder: "x264",
    VideoFramerate: "60",
    VideoFramerateMode: "cfr",
    VideoGrayScale: false,
    VideoScaler: "swscale",
    VideoPreset: "slow",
    VideoTune: "",
    VideoProfile: "high",
    VideoLevel: "4.2",
    VideoOptionExtra: "",
    VideoQualityType: 2,
    VideoQualitySlider: 18,
    VideoMultiPass: false,
    VideoTurboMultiPass: false,
    VideoPasshtruHDRDynamicMetadata: "all",
    x264UseAdvancedOptions: false,
    PresetDisabled: false,
    MetadataPassthru: true,
  };
  return {
    name,
    fileName: `${name.replace(/\s+/g, "-")}.json`,
    json: JSON.stringify({ PresetList: [preset], VersionMajor: 72, VersionMicro: 0, VersionMinor: 0 }, null, 2),
  };
}

// Passi da seguire in HandBrake, in ordine di menu. needs viene da evaluate().
export function handbrakeSteps(info, needs) {
  const { width, height, scaled } = handbrakeTarget(info);
  const { name, fileName } = handbrakePreset(info);
  return [
    { title: "Import the preset", text: `Download the preset below, then in HandBrake: Presets → Import → “${fileName}” and select “${name}”. If you can, open the After Effects master, not an already compressed file.` },
    { title: "Dimensions", text: scaled ? `${width}×${height}: the short side comes down to 1080.` : `${width}×${height}, unchanged.` },
    { title: "Video", text: `H.264 (x264) · Framerate 60 · ${needs?.cfr || needs?.fps ? "“Constant Framerate” (important)" : "Constant Framerate"} · RF 18 · preset slow.` },
    { title: "Peaks", text: "No cap, full quality. When you drop the export here, HQ Upload measures the peaks: above 25 Mbps you can keep them or cap them at 30 or 25." },
    ...(needs?.fps ? [{ title: "Used “Posterize Time”?", text: "Then re-export from After Effects at 60 FPS: every image will last exactly 2 or 3 frames, while HandBrake going from 30 to 60 would duplicate them unevenly (4-2-4-2)." }] : []),
    { title: "Come back", text: "Drop the exported file into HQ Upload: if everything's green, it only applies the patch, without touching the video." },
  ];
}
